question: Will Bitcoin be at or above $85,000 at the start of October 31, 2026 (UTC)?

calls.reasoning: Spot ~$81,450 (CoinGecko, Oct 20 09:20Z); needs +4.4% (ln 0.0427) by the Oct 31 00:00Z snapshot, 10.6 days away. DVOL ~38% gives sigma ~6.5% over the horizon, z~0.66, ~25%; realized vol usually below implied (DVOL overpriced on 74% of days), ~30% vol gives ~20%. Fat tails add a little. Status quo is NO: range-bound $80-85k, ETF outflows, rejected at $83k. Bullish factors: rate-hike odds fell to ~15%, Q4 seasonality. No exact-match human market found; press-reported Polymarket October 'hit $85k' at 66% is a touch contract (much easier than a snapshot) and looks inconsistent with BTC trading near $86.5k on Oct 5, so I treated it as weak evidence only.

calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) vol level — Run 2 used 40-45%, Run 3 realized ~1.5-2% daily, Run 1 DVOL 38%. The CoinGecko daily rows in Run 3's dossier show moves of mostly ~1-2%, consistent with 33-38% annualized, so Run 2's sigma is too high; this gives ~22-26%. (2) ETF flows — one report of a $527M inflow week vs reports of $617-681M outflows; could not settle without web access, so treated as roughly neutral. (3) Polymarket touch market at 66% — a touch contract that conflicts with CoinGecko >$85k on Oct 4-6; given little weight. Spot agreed at ~$81.45k. Final: 0.24.
